data.standardized_narrative: Argenta Syndicate 6134 experienced an overall improvement of GBP 18.6 million on prior years' provisions in 2023, leading to a release of reserves. This was primarily driven by favourable claims development in casualty reinsurance (GBP 18.8 million improvement) and marine reinsurance (GBP 1.1 million improvement), partially offset by adverse claims development in property reinsurance (GBP 1.3 million deterioration). The prior year development figure is assumed to be net of reinsurance as the report does not provide a gross breakdown for the stated overall improvement, and the claims development triangle is distorted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions.
